title: Card-Network Stablecoin Product Lines — Astrology Data

method.minor_points: True Node/South Node and Chiron on every chart; 916 America from the canonical vault JPL Horizons cache where available
method.america_cache_boundary: 2024-01-01 through 2031-01-01; 2014 and 2023 anchors are marked unavailable and are not extrapolated
method.dc_companion: Every stated-place event carries a Washington, D.C. relocation companion at the same instant; national mundane angle reading belongs to the D.C. frame

clock_policy.reported: Use source-supported event time with its stated uncertainty.
clock_policy.noon_proxy: Known daytime event without precise time: 12:00 local synthetic chart.
clock_policy.midnight_proxy: Unknown event time: 00:00 local synthetic chart.

method.us_chart: 1776-07-02 17:10 LMT Philadelphia; locked Sagittarius-rising Freedom 250 chart
